headline: Fitch warns of higher bank risks under BSP capital plan
summary: Fitch Ratings said the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas plan to ease lending risk rules for consumers, small businesses and local government units would free capital for banks. Fitch warned it could also raise risks for lenders.
why: The Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas is the Philippine central bank and sets capital and lending rules that determine how much banks can lend and how risky their books are.
